_source: Your 29-Sep-2026 homework (hammer at the 06-Apr 22,542 support, inverted hammer at the day's high, 8 EMA exit) + MJ / Stock Unlimited wick-at-level teaching. Edit numbers here, not in code.

pattern._rule: Rejection candle: the wick on the level side is at least wick_body_ratio x the body AND at least wick_range_share of the whole candle. The wick touches/pierces the level (within tolerance) but the candle CLOSES back on the right side. Next candle must follow through (same direction, closes beyond the rejection candle's close) - that close is the entry.

levels._rule: Swing = daily low/high with swing_k lower/higher days each side (known only swing_k days later), from the last swing_lookback_days days. Plus previous day high/low/close, today's high/low so far, and your manual levels (data/manual_levels.json, live only).

exit._rule: Target = the nearest opposite level at least 1R away (any level, today's open/high/low); if none, fallback_r x risk. Also tested: exit on a close beyond the 8 EMA against the trade, and whichever of the two comes first. Intraday: anything open is closed at the session's last candle.

telegram._rule: Reversal trades are often AGAINST the day trend (your trade 1 was a CE buy on a bearish day), so the day-trend filter is off for this rule by default. Signals are marked ★ MAIN only if their level type beats random in the backtest.
